title: Needs an icon for "Smoke"
line: The Weather Report widget shows a smoke icon instead of a "?" when Environment Canada reports smoke.
explanation: Environment Canada's icon code 44 (Smoke) was listed with the unsupported codes in both the current-conditions and forecast mappings, so it became Not Available and the widget drew the "?" icon. Code 45 (Dust Storm / Volcanic Ash) had the same problem, and Breeze had no smoke icon at all. The change adds a Smoke condition that uses a new weather-smoke icon (falling back to the fog icon when the theme lacks it), maps EnvCan 44 and NOAA "smoke" reports to it, and maps EnvCan 45 to Haze.

commits.message:
applets/weather: add a Smoke condition with its own icon

Environment Canada's Smoke code was mapped to Not Available, so the
widget showed a "?". Add a Smoke condition, used by EnvCan and NOAA,
with the weather-smoke icon or fog, and show haze for EnvCan dust.

BUG: 523147

applets: add weather-smoke icons

The Weather Report widget had no icon for smoke, such as wildfire
smoke, and showed a "?" or the fog icon instead. Add a colour and a
symbolic weather-smoke icon drawn as two overlapping smoke puffs.

CCBUG: 523147

media.caption: Fake Environment Canada feed reporting Smoke (code 44): "?" for current conditions and both forecast periods (sweep tester, pure master).
Same feed and station with the fix: the new smoke icon for current conditions and both forecast periods.
Regression check: code 23 (Haze, left) unchanged; code 45 (Dust Storm, right) now shows haze instead of "?".

review.text: Mapping EnvCan 44 and NOAA smoke to a new Smoke condition and EnvCan 45 to Haze fixes the '?' properly, and the new breeze-icons pair follows the existing applets/48 weather icons. The QIcon::hasThemeIcon fallback to weather-fog inside the ion library (adding a Qt::Gui link) is a bit unusual for a data provider, and reviewers may prefer the fallback in the applet's QML. It is still acceptable as is.
